name: Bangladesh GeoCodes CodeSystem (BBS geo-codes) in the DGHS Bangladesh Core FHIR IG, Sylhet Division extract
organization: Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS), Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
attribution: Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS), Bangladesh — Bangladesh Core FHIR IG; codes: BBS geo-code system
notes: CodeSystem https://fhir.dghs.gov.bd/core/CodeSystem/bd-geocodes version 0.5.0, status draft, date 2026-10-15T00:09:54+00:00, 1591 codes nationally. Divisions, districts, upazilas/city thanas, city corporations and paurashavas only: no union-level codes (only 'Unions Of X Upazila' placeholders). The IG does not say which BBS release the codes come from. Skipped entries: 603600 Habiganj N/A (district placeholder (no city corporation)); 6036008705 Unions of Shayestaganj (union-group placeholder, no union names in this list); 605800 Moulvibazar N/A (district placeholder (no city corporation)); 609000 Sunamganj N/A (district placeholder (no city corporation)); 609100 Sylhet N/A (district placeholder (no city corporation)); 6091506250 Sylhet City Corp. (part of the city corporation inside thana Sylhet Sadar); plus 39 'Unions Of ... Upazila' placeholders.
